topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by linking prior histopathology practical observations to cellular changes and outlining the lecture's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology, Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical investigation of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Functional Classification and Genetic Mechanics of Cancer Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and mutation categories by exploring their effects on cell cycle checkpoints and mutant allele interactions.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic and Chromosomal Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the distinct pathways, repair defects, replication errors, and mitotic aberrations that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-Step Progression, Hereditary Predisposition, and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the multi-step model of tumor development and examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate carcinogenesis and influence tumor evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the session, offering recommended reading and previewing the next lecture.
